metadata.name: DPINeuron
metadata.author: Chicca, E.; Indiveri, G.
metadata.description: DYNAP-SE differential-pair integrator subthreshold current-mode LIF (Chicca et al. 2014) — explicit-Euler discretisation

extensions.current_domain_note: State and input are transistor currents (nA), so i_mem stays non-negative under any non-negative drive; the source model's max(i_mem, 0) rectification guard is therefore inert across this schema's operating regime and is omitted from the continuous update.
